Always give a summary of the commits that tells:

 - Is the commit safe. Every single file should be scanned one by one
 - Any issues and how to fix them should also be told ("As merging sometimes creates conflicts")
 - The commit should be described in simple english if the english in the commit is hard...!

If the Commit has a security risk... State it in BIG Letters that there is a issue, DO not hesitate!

Also if there are changes to .github/skills/code-review which change this file, Note that as well!
